feeds.title: Gluten Free Blogger
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sarah Howells, aka The Gluten Free Blogger. I share gluten-free recipes and advice for living life with coeliac disease. From simple gluten-free bakes to meal ideas, coeliac humor, and more, The Gluten-Free Blogger has everything you need to start living and loving your gluten-free life.

feeds.title: Gluten Free on a Shoestring
feeds.description: Gluten-free recipes that really work for everything from bread, pasta and cakes to DIY flour blends, and appetizers. It's all here! I'm Nicole Hunn. I started this blog, Gluten-Free on a Shoestring, in March 2009. Gluten-Free on a Shoestring helps make feeding your family a gluten-free diet enjoyable and affordable.

feeds.title: Gluten-Free Baking
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Elizabeth. If you want easy and delicious gluten-free recipes, you're in the right place. Not only are the recipes here gluten-free, but many are also dairy-free, egg-free, nut-free, soy-free, and grain-free. If you eat gluten-free, whether because of celiac disease, a gluten intolerance, or because you just feel better on the diet, you are welcome here.

feeds.title: Sallys Baking Addiction » Gluten Free
feeds.description: Here are all of my natural gluten-free recipes where regular flour simply isn't needed, like Flourless Chocolate Cake and Lace Cookies. My name is Sally. I'm a baker, blogger, cookbook author, and food photographer. I live in Maryland with my little family of four and our rescue dogs

feeds.title: Bakerita » Baked Goods
feeds.description: I'm Rachel, and in this segment, you'll discover a bunch of various baked recipes. I'm a gluten-free and vegan baker and recipe developer with a passion for creating easy recipes that will make your mouth water! I hope you find a recipe you love.

feeds.title: Let Them Eat Gluten Free Cake
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kim. Welcome to Let Them Eat Gluten Free Cake. My goal for this little blog site is to share with you my successes with gluten-free baking and cooking that will hopefully make you a champion in your own kitchen.

feeds.title: Just As Tasty
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Taleen. Setting out to make allergy-friendly baking as easy and approachable as possible. Find the best gluten-free dessert recipes here. Your go-to gluten-free baking resource, with tons of easy gluten-free and eggless dessert recipes, plus general tips for living with food allergies.

feeds.title: Butternut Bakery » Gluten Free
feeds.description: Follow Butternut Bakery and get allergy-friendly gluten-free recipes. Hi, I'm Jenna. The baker and photographer behind Butternut Bakery. I'm passionate about creating desserts for all diets. Here you'll find a mix of traditional and modified recipes to satisfy every sweet tooth.

feeds.title: The Gluten Free Bakery Blog
feeds.description: Get all of the latest news on our delicious range of gluten-free bread mixes, plus news, events, where to buy our bread, and more. The Gluten Free Bakery delivers freshly made gluten free sourdough bread, bagels, buns and baguettes to your door- all over the UK.

feeds.title: MinusG Baking Co.
feeds.description: MinusG is a dream coming true. My name is Katherine Krage, a 5th generation baker and I'm living without compromise. The lack of tasty gluten-free options in the market has been the driving force behind MinusG. It's my passion to share how those with celiac disease can have exceptionally great-tasting food and to provide solutions to those who struggle with allergies and their health.

feeds.title: Simona Gluten-Free
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog. My name is Simona. I want to share my baking with anyone who is looking for the same flavors and tastes I was craving. I want to reach out to anyone who has spent meal after meal at the corner of a table, pretending to enjoy a cardboard substitute dessert, under the pity of the other diners. My Italian tradition and my American adoption mix together in a variety of recipes. I hope you will enjoy them all.

feeds.title: A Clean Bake Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nora and I am here to help you eat well on a gluten free, grain-free, and refined sugar-free diet without ever feeling restricted or deprived! Browse gluten free and paleo recipes that will delight everyone at the table! You don't have to eat paleo or gluten-free to enjoy these dishes and desserts!

feeds.title: Vegan Richa » Gluten Free Baking
feeds.description: Find gluten-free baked goods like cookies, cakes, quick breads, muffins, flatbreads, and pizza crusts. Hi, I am Richa. I am the award-winning recipe developer, blogger, and photographer behind VeganRicha.com. My instructions are easy to follow and step-by-step photographs welcome the uninitiated into their kitchen as vouched by millions of readers.

feeds.title: The Infinebalance Food Blog » Gluten-Free
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Trish and if you are following a gluten-free diet, these recipes are for you. These gluten-free recipes include gluten-free baked goods but also mains, sides, and other dishes that are naturally gluten-free. I'm a curious home cook, just as enthusiastic about healthy ingredients and whole foods as I am about cookies.

feeds.title: Gluten-Free Makeovers
feeds.description: Find the latest recipe classics and family favorites made deliciously gluten free with baking guru Beth Hillson

feeds.title: Divinely Gluten Free Blog
feeds.description: Divinely Gluten Free is dedicated to creating both delicious and healthier gluten-free baking mixes and gluten-free products. Our gluten-free baking mixes and other gluten-free products contain ethically sourced non-GMO gluten-free certified ingredients.

feeds.title: Becky Excell
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Becky Excell. Welcome to my gluten-free food blog. I'm a London/Essex-based food writer, recipe creator, and a Sunday Times best-selling author. The blog covers baking, breakfast, lunch, dinner, desserts, dairy-free, vegan, low fodmap, and smoothies recipes. Also covers articles on life and travel.
